records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Cedar Partners!
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Re: Cancellation timing
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Thanks again for raising the cancellation timing question — your ticket is still open on our side and a colleague is looking at it, so you'll hear back on the specifics. For context, a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately.

Since we spoke last week I also want to make sure nothing in Wrenfield itself got in the way. If it's useful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through whatever's blocking you — or just reply here and I'll pick it up from your message.

Best,
Nadia
